title: MATRIX SERVICE CO 8-K Filing — 2026-04-30
summary: Matrix Service Company (MTRX), a NASDAQ-listed industrial services firm headquartered in Tulsa, Oklahoma, filed a Form 8-K disclosing the departure of its CFO Kevin S. Cavanah and Chief Administrative Officer Nancy E. Austin as part of organizational changes following the previously announced appointment of Shawn P. Payne as CEO (effective July 1, 2026). Cavanah will continue through the earlier of one week after the FY2026 10-K filing or termination without cause; Austin steps down May 7, 2026. Both separations are amicable with no disagreements cited.
key_points: CFO Kevin S. Cavanah to serve through transition period ending one week after FY2026 10-K filing or earlier termination without cause
CAO Nancy E. Austin steps down effective May 7, 2026
No CEO replacement will be appointed; responsibilities redistributed to existing executives
Cavanah receives $771,000 lump sum, 18 months COBRA, RSU vesting, and partial performance unit vesting
Austin receives $608,345 lump sum, 18 months COBRA, and vesting of 20,368 RSUs
Both agreements include confidentiality, cooperation, non-disparagement covenants, and release of claims
